summary: The WorksheetSummary handles the processing and display of worksheet statistics in different categories including group worksheets, individual worksheets without CFO involvement, and individual worksheets with CFO involvement.
purpose: To provide a structured overview of worksheets including those not sent, remaining enrollments, and assignments, assisting in managing and tracking worksheet processing.

workflows.name: Group Worksheet Processing
steps: Process database records for worksheet counts.
Iterate through result sets for specific worksheet statistics.
Generate URLs and controls for displaying results.

business_rules: Worksheets are processed based on session parameters and course ID when specified.
Links and UI controls are enabled or disabled based on worksheet counts.
validations: Check worksheet counts to determine link availability.
calculations: Count of worksheets not sent (GWS, IWS non-CFO, IWS CFO).
conditions: Links are created only if worksheet counts are greater than zero.
system_behavior: UI elements are disabled if there are no remaining worksheet spaces.
exceptions: If session data or database connection fails, processing cannot occur.
